target.label: OpenRPC
target.description: Export as an OpenRPC JSON-RPC 2.0 service description.

items.message: OpenRPC describes JSON-RPC methods; this REST API's operations are reframed as methods with by-name params, and it reads back as an RPC API
The document is written as an OpenRPC service description and reads back as a JSON-RPC API, with its title, version and servers in `info` and `servers`

A JSON-RPC result has no status; the 204 status of 'DELETE /pets/{petId}' is not carried.
JSON-RPC has no HTTP method or path; DELETE /pets/{petId} is the method 'deletePet' (the binding is kept only as the x-http extension, which JSON-RPC clients ignore).
An OpenRPC error carries a data value, not a schema; the payload type of 'DELETE /pets/{petId}#response.404' is not written.
JSON-RPC errors have codes, not HTTP statuses; the 404 error response(s) of 'DELETE /pets/{petId}' are errors with that number as their code.
JSON-RPC params have no location; path petId of 'DELETE /pets/{petId}' become by-name params (each description names its location).
